entries.target: An infinite range attack that deals damage to 1 target.
entries.officialDescription: Chaos manifests itself, dealing damage while randomly reducing your target's Dodge, Crit Chance, Hit Chance, Haste, and outgoing damage. Each debuff reduces its respective stat by 30% for 20 seconds. Also applies Focus for 4 seconds, which forces your target to attack only you for the duration. Can’t miss and always crits.
notes: Evasion Chaorrupted: Decreases enemy dodge chance by 30% (100% chance of activation)
Crit Chance Chaorrupted: Decreases enemy crit chance by 30% (100% chance of activation)
Accuracy Chaorrupted: Decreases enemy accuracy by 30% (50% chance of activation)
Damage Chaorrupted: Decreases enemy outgoing damage by 30% (40% chance of activation)
Haste Chaorrupted: Decreases enemy haste by 30% (30% chance of activation)
